objective: Verify stopped offline records against an explicit full task/variant/repeat matrix, preserve missing results and unknown costs, and expose a bounded managed aggregation command.
implementation: Strict frozen evaluation manifest and full matrix; task/log uniqueness and configuration, capability, budget, prompt, condition/protocol and catalog-selection identity checks.
Read-only immutable SQLite helper and read_only stores/check ledger; replay-only executor cannot load answers or execute checks.
Original path chain, regular-file/hardlink/sidecar and before/after input-tree checks. Business JSON preserved as raw source bytes; host JSON remains strict.
Read_completion-backed rows retain initial/latest/candidate-linked localization, all ordinal candidates, first/latest checks, compactions and total accounted costs.
Reconstructed installed host and solver wire tool descriptors; no provider or tool execution. Historical execution versions and ordinary original request bodies are not invented.
Missing/not_run remain in all denominators; total costs stay unknown where evidence or usage is missing; paired repeats remain grouped by declared task/lineage.
Managed aggregate task reuses Job limits and serialization, writes new report and terminal marker, prints bounded receipt. C# scenario allowlist updated after actual smoke rejection.

validation.mode: 10 selected test files, managed sequential runs; not a single full-repository test run
validation.skip_reason: Current Windows account cannot create symbolic links; actual hardlinks and unmerged SQLite WAL rejection were exercised.
corrected_failures: Initial Ruff two style findings corrected without changing evidence rejection semantics.
Actual aggregate Job smoke rejected before child creation because C# scenario allowlist did not contain aggregate; added fixed task and successful rerun.
A premature attempt to start another test while an earlier managed test was still running was rejected as busy; the next run waited for completion. No task bypassed the manager.

environment.evidence_retention: Synthetic inputs and work outputs retained locally pending W10. Test basetemp cleaned by managed runner.

limitations: No ground truth, application admission, business correctness/regression evidence, repair effectiveness, actual cloud costs or measured localization/repair timing.
Schema-1 lineage/case metadata is a manifest declaration; schema-2 hashes bind catalog identity, not independent cases or application admission.
Historical Git commit, lock hash and SDK execution version were absent from schema-8 sessions and remain unknown.
Ordinary original solver request bodies and the entire stop process are not reconstructible from the current source records.
Terminal marker and tree snapshots do not lock arbitrary external concurrent writers.
Force-stopped output without a terminal marker remains protected from automatic cleanup.
Managed export, real provider transport and local HarmonyOS execution still unimplemented.
next: W10 managed evidence export, source retention and replay verification on synthetic fixtures; real work continues only after W08 prerequisites and user arrangements.
